component.text: The Barrel Press accepts three compatible fruits and a glass bottle, then compresses them into two portions of Wine Must. Apples, sweet berries, glow berries and melon slices are suitable feedstock.
Wine Must is the biological feedstock for ethanol. Combine it with sugar and water in a Chemical Synthesizer to refine ethanol efficiently.

Sterilizing solution, surfactants, chemical-resistant coating, vaccine cloning and other ethanol-based processes now inherit this production step. JEI lists every valid fruit through the Barrel Press category.
